changelog: Security hardening: upgrade and pin Playwright 1.62.1, add a reproducible lockfile, disable dependency lifecycle scripts, make browser download explicit, narrow stealth activation, and document permissions and safety boundaries.
summary: Opt-in Playwright stealth wrapper for websites the user owns or is explicitly authorized to test. Use only when the user explicitly requests stealth or a documented bot-detection block prevents authorized automation; do not invoke for generic browsing or scraping. Not a CAPTCHA solver.
